entities.summary: Rafael Lozano Serrano, also known as Rafael Lozano or Rafael Lozano Jr., is a Spanish boxer. He competed at the 2024 European Amateur Boxing Championships, winning the bronze medal in the flyweight event. He also competed at the 2024 Summer Olympics in the men's 51 kg event, but was defeated in the quarter-final by Yunior Alcántara Reyes.
